messages:
kai: Heads-up — prototyping a Grafana dashboard to surface GPU energy profiles, per-region power draw, and SLO cost breakdowns. Want quick eyes on panels + alert criteria before I commit the JSON.

maria: nice. is this aimed at ops only or will product/finance use it for chargeback?

kai: ops primary, but I want a templated panel for finance to compute $/token estimates per model/pool. thinking of joining power metrics with token throughput.

sam: agree on $/token. one approach: derive watts/sec -> kWh and multiply by $/kWh for region. then divide by tokens/sec.

lucy: can you share the PromQL for power? we'll need consistent labels across exporters (rack/host/gpu_id).

kai: putting a draft snippet below for the power panel (host-level) — open to improvements:

```
sum by (instance) (nvidia_gpu_power_watts{job="gpu_exporter",region=~"$region"})
/ 1000  # convert W -> kW for kWh calc in downstream
```

maria: might be better to keep watts as raw and convert in a transform panel so finance team can toggle kWh price.

sam: alert tuning thought: avoid firing on short thermal spikes. use a for: 5m and percentiles across GPUs in a pool. e.g.

```
max_over_time(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes[10m]) / nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes > 0.95
```

kai: good call. propose these panels: utilization heatmap (per-cluster, per-gpu), moving-window thermal percentiles, power draw by tenant tag, cost-per-token trend, and an anomaly panel for sudden power jumps.

lucy: add a panel that breaks down SLO violations by model version. we had a postmortem where a quantized rollout increased token time by 20% and widened power usage.

maria: for templating: $cluster, $region, $tenant. also add a toggle for lookback (1h/6h/24h).

kai: will do. one more PromQL for kWh per token (draft):

```
# kWh/sec per instance, then divide by tokens/sec
(sum by (instance) (nvidia_gpu_power_watts{job="gpu_exporter"})) / 1000
/ sum by (instance) (rate(app_tokens_generated_total[1m]))
```

sam: watch out for label cardinality on app_tokens_generated_total if tokens are emitted per-request. better to aggregate by pool label.

infra-bot: dashboard-lint: 1 warning — panel "cost-per-token" uses mixed units. Recommend adding unit formatting and description.

kai: thanks infra-bot. I'll standardize units and add descriptions. planning to land dashboard JSON in repo/infra/grafana/dashboards/gpu-energy-profile.json and link it in the PR.

lucy: can you also add an alert that triggers when PUE spikes in a region (cooling issue) — we saw this in us-west last month.

kai: yes — will add PUE panel and a composite alert: if region PUE > 1.8 for 10m AND avg GPU temp > 78C -> paging.

maria: LGTM. ping us when draft PR is up and we'll review the queries. :thumbsup:

kai: will do. thanks all.
